授業概要
人体表現、顔の特徴、骨格関節、2D人物検出、トラッキング、姿勢推定などの基礎理論を講義とチュートリアルで実践的に学びます。 多視点3D撮影や3D姿勢推定などの高度な内容を講義と演習で実践的に学習します。 特に、Pytorch とGoogleLab を使用して自動 2D 人物検出を作成します。 シミュレーション結果の比較など、具体例を交えながら講義を行います。
Basic theories such as human body representation, facial features, skeletal joints, 2D person detection, tracking, pose estimation etc., are learned practically through lectures and tutorials. Advanced content such as multiview 3D capture and 3D pose estimation are learned practically through lectures and exercises. In particular we create an automatic 2D person detection using Pytorch and GoogleLab. Lectures will be given with concrete examples such as comparison of simulation results.

全体の教育目標
The overall goal is to understand basic representations of the human in the computer and how to build them from images and videos. The main goal is to obtain a good understanding about what strategies exist, what are the key ideas, advantages and inconvenients.

2. Face detection
3. Facial landmarks detection and tracking
4. Pedestrian detection, identification and tracking
5. 2D human pose estimation
6. Multi-view 3D human pose estimation
